description: This file contains the 'WorldPayEvents' class which handles integration events/services for WorldPay within the Ofbiz framework, including request handling, notification processing, and payment preference updates.

classes.name: WorldPayEvents
classes.description: Handles WorldPay payment integration events including processing payment requests and notifications.

methods.name: worldPayRequest
methods.description: Prepares and redirects the user to WorldPay payment gateway with necessary transaction details.

methods.name: worldPayNotify
methods.description: Handles callback notifications from WorldPay and updates order and payment status accordingly.

methods.name: setPaymentPreferences
methods.description: Updates payment preferences based on the notification from WorldPay.

methods.name: setPaymentPreference
methods.description: Processes individual payment preference update and records response details.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for the WorldPay gateway, either from the entity or properties files.
